# OpenGate Data

> OpenGate Data helps MCA brokers and ISOs find new opportunities in declined files, stacked MCA situations and other hard-to-place commercial funding submissions. Beyond Fundable. Beyond Conventional.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.opengatedata.com/): OpenGate Data helps MCA brokers and ISOs find new opportunities in declined files and stacked MCA situations. 300+ referral partners nationwide.
- [Broker Program](https://www.opengatedata.com/broker-program/): Submit eligible declined and stacked MCA files for a specialty review. Your own CRM board, an assigned underwriter and commissions on files that convert.
- [Declined Lead Monetization](https://www.opengatedata.com/declined-lead-monetization/): Recover potential value from eligible declined business funding leads. Submit files lenders passed on and earn commissions on the ones that convert.
- [Gateway Consolidators](https://www.opengatedata.com/gateway-consolidators/): Gateway Consolidators reviews businesses carrying multiple merchant cash advances and lays out options to bring those obligations into one manageable plan.
- [Records](https://www.opengatedata.com/records/): OpenGate Records: UCC filings, MCA submission data and responder lists, sourced with consent and delivered by CRM upload, CSV, API or PDF.
- [How It Works](https://www.opengatedata.com/how-it-works/): Five steps from first call to commission: connect, submit securely, get a file on your CRM board within hours, advance with an underwriter, and get paid on conversions.
- [Submission Criteria](https://www.opengatedata.com/submission-criteria/): What to send OpenGate: $30K+ in MCA debt and $8K+ in combined monthly obligations as a guide, merchant details, MCA positions and recent bank statements.
- [About](https://www.opengatedata.com/about/): OpenGate Data helps commercial funding professionals find value in hard-to-place files. Based in Boca Raton, Florida, working with 300+ referral partners nationwide.
- [Contact](https://www.opengatedata.com/contact/): Contact OpenGate Data in Boca Raton, Florida. Brokers and ISOs can submit a deal or book a call; business owners can request a confidential Gateway review.
- [Submit a Deal](https://www.opengatedata.com/submit-a-deal/): Submit a declined or stacked MCA file to OpenGate Data through a secure upload. Within hours it's on your CRM board with an underwriter ready to call.
- [Resources](https://www.opengatedata.com/resources/): Guides for MCA brokers and ISOs on declined deals, stacked merchants, MCA consolidation and choosing a referral partner.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.opengatedata.com/privacy-policy/): How OpenGate Data collects, uses, shares and protects information submitted by brokers, partners and businesses.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.opengatedata.com/terms/): Terms and conditions for using the OpenGate Data website and services.
